Initial release of native-ui: opinionated patterns for native mobile UIs with Expo Router and React Native.

- Covers routing, navigation, tabs, native controls, animations, and styling (with Apple HIG best practices).
- Includes detailed notes on responsive layouts, safe area handling, and file organization.
- Recommends preferred libraries and Expo modules; lists deprecated/unsupported APIs.
- Documents navigation with Expo Router, context menus, link previews, modals, and sheets.
- Provides code style guidance, file naming conventions, and comprehensive references for deeper topics.
